About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

At Ping Identity, we help enterprises protect millions of identities every day. Our industry-leading solutions in multi-factor authentication (MFA), fraud detection, risk-based access, and identity verification deliver secure, seamless digital experiences for some of the world’s largest organizations.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Specialist to join our team and serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for these critical solutions. This highly customer-facing role is your opportunity to combine deep technical knowledge with relationship-building skills—supporting enterprise customers, gathering feedback from the field, and partnering with our product teams to influence the future of identity security.

What You’ll Do

  • Represent the company with executive presence, delivering roadmap presentations and strategic briefings tailored for C-suite and senior leadership audiences.
  • Lead high-impact technical discussions and workshops, providing deep expertise across authentication, fraud detection, risk engines, and identity verification.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, framing technical solutions in the context of business outcomes, regulatory compliance, and risk management.
  • Act as a key voice of the field—capturing insights from customer engagements and market trends to influence product strategy and long-term roadmap.
  • Partner with account teams and solution engineers on critical customer engagements, ensuring successful evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and production deployments.
  • Create and deliver executive-ready enablement materials (strategic solution briefs, decision-maker guides, and thought leadership content) alongside technical resources like demo scripts and deep-dive guides.
  • Stay ahead of the curve by tracking emerging standards and technologies in identity, authentication, and fraud prevention, bringing a forward-looking perspective to customers and internal stakeholders.

What You Bring

Description

We're looking for a hands-on Commodity Buyer to own US purchasing for two of Hal Leonard's core direct-material categories: Sheet Music and Musical Instruments. This is a newly structured seat under our Global Purchasing function — the first of a new model where each buyer owns a defined set of commodities end-to-end, rather than a single narrow category.

We are actively integrating AI and automation into all areas of the business and expect candidates with a mindset focused on improving efficiency and delivering a better user experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Own US Sheet Music and Musical Instruments direct-material purchasing end-to-end — supplier landscape, sourcing, POs, order confirmations, master data and price files for both categories.
  • Document and stabilise the inherited MI category first — rebuild supplier contacts, open POs, terms and product knowledge into a clean, shared record (not one person's head).
  • Bring Sheet Music buying (paper, print, binding) into the same structure — one owned category with documented suppliers and terms.
  • Protect US direct-material supply into the holiday peak — no availability gaps on either category attributable to the handover.
  • Work AI-first — operate the tiered approval model, feed the spend cube, use automated PO/confirmation workflows rather than manual handling.
  • Negotiate and consolidate — standard terms, framework agreements and a tidier supplier base; support the Global Purchasing Manager's savings target on these commodities.
  • Feed the ERP transition (NetSuite track) so US direct-material procurement requirements are captured, not bolted on later.
  • Report performance into the Global Purchasing Manager / operations leadership.

Requirements

  • 4–7+ years in direct-material purchasing / buying / commodity management, ideally across more than one commodity — this role runs two (Sheet Music and Musical Instruments).
  • Hands-on ownership of the full buy cycle: sourcing, PO management, order confirmation, supplier communication, master-data hygiene.
  • AI-comfort as a must, not a footnote — sees AI-assisted approval and automated PO workflows as leverage; can judge what to automate vs. keep human.
  • Strong supplier-negotiation instinct; a track record of documented savings or supplier consolidation.
  • Discipline with data — clean records, accurate price files, no "it's all in my head" working.

Nice to have:

  • Direct-material category experience in paper / print, publishing, or musical instruments.
  • Prior purchasing inside an ERP migration (NetSuite a plus).
  • Bachelor's in Business, Supply Chain or related; CPSM / CPM.

Job Title: Senior Cybersecurity A&A Risk Analyst

Job Code: IT1068

Location: Remote

Reports to: Program Manager

FLSA Status: Exempt

Supervisory: No supervisory/management authority

Prepared Date: 10/9/2026

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.

This position requires an active Public Trust clearance or the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance to be considered.

Position Summary:

The Senior Cybersecurity Assessment & Authorization (A&A) Risk Analyst provides advanced governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) support to federal information systems in alignment with the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) and the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF).This position is responsible for managing external service authorization activities, conducting security risk assessments, and supporting NSF’s continuous monitoring efforts. The role requires strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills to ensure federal systems maintain compliance with applicable federal laws, regulations, and directives.

This is a full-time remote position supporting Cherokee Federal’s cybersecurity contract with the U.S. National Science Foundation in Alexandria, VA. This position reports to the Cybersecurity Oversight and Compliance Lead, operates within a structured federal compliance environment, and requires collaboration with system owners, security personnel, program offices, and senior stakeholders. The role supports ongoing authorization, governance initiatives, and periodic oversight reviews to maintain a strong cybersecurity posture across systems.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Senior Cybersecurity A&A Risk Analyst: $130,000 – $135,000

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays

•Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes the following:

  • Manage full lifecycle Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities in accordance with NIST Special Publication 800-37.
  • Develop, review, and maintain security authorization documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Plans (SAPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Review and assess FedRAMP authorization packages, and package updates, to support the evaluation and use of cloud services.
  • Monitor ATO packages in the FedRAMP Secure Repository
  • Communicate with system owners, information systems security officers (ISSOs), Cloud Service Providers, and security stakeholders frequently to review significant system changes and ensure continued compliance with federal security requirements.
  • Evaluate and validate implementation of security controls defined in NIST Special Publication 800-53 Rev. 5, including inherited and agency-implemented controls.

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Digital Ads Manager to join our Advertising Area.

When you come work for us, here’s what you’ll find:

  • Work that is meaningful. We are a fast-paced, deadline-driven consulting firm that only works with nonprofit clients who are essential to advancing the cause of justice, alleviating suffering, and solving the greatest challenges we face.
  • Commitment to Anti-Racism, Equity, and Inclusion (AEI). We envision an anti-oppressive workplace that ensures an inclusive employee experience, promotes equitable outcomes for staff, and supports clients to center accessibility and anti-racism in their programs.
  • Colleagues you can count on. Kind, dedicated, passionate people who work collaboratively to get things done and help you do your best.
  • An organization that embraces change. We strive to improve and adapt and always seek new ways that we can contribute to a just, inclusive, and sustainable world. We are also continually working on making M+R a better place for our staff.

So that’s us. Now about the work:

  • We run advertising campaigns that raise money and create change for our clients. Great big ones you read about in the news and tiny ones you’ve never heard of that are saving lives. Lots of politically progressive groups – Planned Parenthood and League of Conservation Voters, PETA. Environmental groups such as NRDC and Oceana, and our clients also include organizations that are working in the most dire situations in the world such as the International Rescue Committee.
  • Day-to-day, we’re raising revenue, acquiring new donors and supporters, winning campaigns and elections, and improving brand and issue recognition.

Here’s what you’ll be doing in this role:

  • Work in advertising tools to implement and optimize digital advertising campaigns across our clients. This includes display/retargeting, video, mobile, SEM, and Facebook advertising.
  • Place and monitor media buys – and make adjustments as necessary to optimize results.
  • Evaluate digital advertising performance – produce detailed reports on campaigns.
  • Project management: Keep task lists, meetings agendas, and communications calendars across your clients.
  • Participate in client strategy and media planning meetings.
  • Research new advertising venues and stay abreast of online advertising trends; develop and maintain relationships with vendors and partners.
  • Do your part to help us run smoothly, including carefully tracking all of your hours.

Skills and experiences required for this role:

  • 2-4 years of work experience with at least 1 year of experience in a dedicated digital advertising role, focused on media buying or trafficking.
  • Proficiency in any two of the following: programmatic display, paid social, or paid search.
  • Familiarity with all aspects of ad campaign management: campaign setup, ad trafficking, optimizations and reporting and analysis.
  • Ability to manipulate and analyze data in reporting systems such as Excel.
    • We love hearing from anyone who strives to make the world a better place! Not sure if you meet all of the qualifications? There is no harm in applying! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply!

Skills and experiences we expect of all M+R employees:

  • Demonstrated commitment to anti-racism, equity, and inclusion.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively to gain trust and give respect to others through honesty, integrity, kindness, empathy, and authenticity.
  • Acute attention to detail and demonstrated ability to prioritize time to meet deadlines for multiple projects.
  • Proven track record to successfully pick up new skills, including learning new technologies.
  • Drive to seek what can be improved and offer ways to fix any potential roadblocks.
  • Comfort admitting what you don’t know and recognizing that feedback is part of the learning process.
  • Strong ability to relay your ideas clearly verbally and in writing.

Skills and experiences that are preferred, but not required:

  • Experience using one of the following ad serving systems: Google Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Verizon (formerly Oath), or Facebook Ads Manager.
  • Experience working at an agency.
  • Experience working with or at non-profits or political/issue campaigns.
  • Basic understanding of pixel and pixel management.
  • Experience with direct response (DR) advertising.

Salary and Benefits:

  • This is an exempt, unionized position, represented by the Washington-Baltimore News Guild. The salary for this position is $81,400. As part of M+R’s commitment to compensation equity and transparency, we have a no negotiation policy. Salary negotiations can introduce bias and perpetuate wage inequality. Staff at M+R who successfully meet their performance expectations have regular opportunities for promotion with accompanying increases in compensation.
    • We also offer a generous benefits package:
  • A 36-hour workweek with half-day Fridays and scheduling flexibility;
  • Three weeks of vacation and 17 paid sick days;
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits with premiums fully paid for by M+R for individual employees;
  • 401(k) plan;
  • Discretionary profit-sharing contributions;
  • Annual $1,250 professional development stipend for qualified educational expenses;
  • Flexible Spending Accounts for medical, dependent care, and transit;
  • 11 holidays and a Mid-summer break the week of July 4;
  • Exceptional paid Parental, Personal Medical & Family Caregiving leave policies.

The fine print:

M+R is currently able to hire candidates who reside in the following states: AK, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, ID, IL, KS, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, MT, NE, NV, NH, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, VT, VA, DC, WA, WI, WY. If you do not live in a state where we are currently registered, we may not be able to hire you for a currently open position. However, we welcome you to apply and if we are able to hire in your state we will contact you.
Staff working from an M+R office are required to be vaccinated against COVID-19, and all staff will be asked to provide information regarding their vaccine status.
To apply, use the button on this page. No calls please.

Our Hiring Process:

We aim to be transparent and efficient in our hiring process. Each question you will be asked throughout our hiring process ties directly back to one of the skills and experiences listed above. In each interview, you will be asked to provide examples of these skills and experiences or how you would draw on your experience to handle a scenario commonly found at M+R. Our typical hiring process includes:
1) Phone Interview
2) Written Skills Assessment
3) Video Interview(s)
4) Reference Check
Depending on logistics and scheduling, our hiring process generally takes about 6 weeks from phone interview to a job offer. There is no application deadline; we review applications on a rolling basis. M+R has developed an application stage informational document that some candidates may find helpful. We let candidates know after each step in the process, once we’ve made a decision, whether they are moving forward to the next stage or not, so candidates know the status of their application. If you need accommodations for this application process or any of the hiring process steps listed above, please email or call 202-681-8743.
M+R is an equal opportunity employer and all applicants will be considered. As a firm we are committed to being an anti-racist, equitable, and inclusive organization where all staff feel welcomed, valued, and empowered, resulting in meaningful, rewarding, and enriching experiences throughout their careers here. We work to center our AEI values in all aspects of our work, so our culture, clientele, policies, and practices are reflective and affirming of people -- inclusive of their race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, immigration status, citizenship status, and so much more. We strongly encourage folks from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

Job Title

Senior Project Manager - PMO Lead

Job Description Summary

The Senior Project Manager provides project management experience to designated projects and assignments for a particular client account, property portfolio, or large facility/complex through interaction with the client, property or facility management team, and project management staff. Monitors and coordinates the execution of the various services and processes relating to client contracted agreements for project management and tenant improvement consulting services. May supervise one or more project managers, space planners, and/or CAD operators. Works closely with and provides detailed progress reports to the Account Manager/Director or Portfolio Manager in addition to the building/facility management team.

Job Description

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and schedule meetings, prepare agendas, develop and maintain master project budgets and timelines as required for each project and project phase to ensure overall project objectives and client needs are met
  • Prepare and coordinate project reports and drawing reviews for clients, Account/Portfolio Manager, and property/facility management team at all project phases including conceptual, schematic, design development and construction phases
  • Assist in the selection and contracting process and oversight of consultants and construction teams as necessary for each project. If appropriate/applicable, integrate the impact of other Project Management and C&W components, including brokerage (work letter development), building operations, M.E.P., etc. as they relate to each project and project phase
  • Review requisitions, change orders and other invoices associated with the project; advise and counsel the Account Director and building/facility management team
  • Directly participate in the marketing and presentation of services to clients
  • May supervise and manage the performance, development, work quality, reporting, and activities of Project Managers, Space Planners, and CAD Operators
  • Provide all necessary documentation and reports to the client and building/facility management team
  • Cooperate with other building/facility personnel to achieve corporate goals and objectives as to quality, service, cost and profit
  • Report to the Account Director regarding major problems and findings and results achieved along with specific, complete, and comprehensive recommendations
  • Provide the appropriate documentation and obtain the approvals necessary in advance of making organizational changes, actions planned, implying commitments, and expenditures in excess of approved budget
  • May be required to establish goals and objectives with timetables for the organizational unit and sub-units supervised
  • May be required to select and hire subordinates; delegate to each necessary authority and responsibility for performance of assigned functions
  • May be required to train, develop, motivate and discipline subordinates as necessary to meet established goals; review and appraise their work performance
  • Implement government laws and regulations and adheres to established rulings of government authorities

KEY COMPETENCIES

1. Client Focus

2. Communication Proficiency (oral and written)

3. Leadership

4. Technical Proficiency

5. Consultation


IMPORTANT EDUCATION

B.S. Degree in Engineering, Architecture or related area required


IMPORTANT EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 7 years directly related experience in an engineering/construction project accountability role
  • A minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience in a project management capacity especially experience in leading, motivating, and developing employees

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Director, Public Affairs & Strategy will lead high-priority, cross-functional work at the intersection of Humana’s business strategy, healthcare policy, and advocacy. This leader will own complex workstreams from initial framing through recommendation and execution, partnering directly with senior leaders to structure issues, develop policy positions, and build coordinated strategies that advance enterprise priorities.
The ideal candidate is a highly strategic and structured leader with deep healthcare expertise, strong executive presence, and the judgment and emotional intelligence to influence and collaborate across the organization. This role requires an individual who can create clarity from ambiguity, operate with a high degree of ownership and independence, and translate complex business and policy issues into clear recommendations and disciplined execution. This role reports to the
SVP, Strategy & Public Affairs.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead complex workstreams end to end. Define scope, priorities, workplans, milestones, and decisions; anticipate needs and drive work through implementation with limited direction.
  • Advise senior leaders. Frame complex business and policy issues, surface tradeoffs, synthesize perspectives, and translate insights into clear recommendations.
  • Develop strategies to advance enterprise priorities. Connect healthcare policy developments to business objectives and build coordinated strategies across stakeholders, messaging, risks, and execution.
  • Drive analysis and execution. Lead research, quantitative and qualitative analysis, and scenario planning while establishing clear accountability, timelines, and follow-through.
  • Create executive-ready deliverables. Distill complex information into concise, high-quality presentations, briefings, memos, and decision materials.
  • Lead through influence. Build trust and alignment across functions, navigate differing perspectives, manage external consulting partners, and maintain a high bar for rigor, quality, and results.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications


  • BA/BS degree; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, healthcare strategy, enterprise transformation, public affairs strategy, or a similarly rigorous, high-performance environment.
  • Deep knowledge of the U.S. healthcare industry, preferably including payer and/or provider experience.
  • Proven ability to independently structure ambiguous problems, lead complex cross-functional work, synthesize quantitative and qualitative findings, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to take full ownership of complex workstreams and drive execution with limited direction.
  • Exceptional project leadership, executive communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Strong executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and stakeholders without formal authority.
  • High emotional intelligence with the ability to build trust, navigate disagreement, and foster alignment across diverse perspectives.
  • Sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.


Leadership Attributes

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

  • Strategic and structured: Creates clarity from ambiguity, approaches complex issues with a structured mindset, and connects policy developments to enterprise priorities.
  • Ownership and execution: Takes full accountability for outcomes, anticipates needs, drives work forward with limited direction, and consistently delivers high-quality, synthesized work.
  • Influential and collaborative: Builds trust, works effectively across organizational boundaries, navigates disagreement constructively, and creates alignment without relying on formal authority.
  • Clear and concise: Distills complexity into the core insight, decision, and recommendation and communicates effectively with senior executives.
  • Low ego, high standards: Collaborates openly, welcomes different perspectives, and puts enterprise outcomes ahead of personal ownership while maintaining a high bar for rigor, quality, and execution.

Location & Travel:

This role offers flexibility in location and may be performed remotely. Candidates are not required to reside near a Humana market office; however, travel will be expected on an as-needed basis to support business priorities, including travel to Louisville, KY; the Washington, DC metro area; Chicago, IL; Nashville, TN; and New York, NY.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

raw.description:
Über das Syntax Institut (ine Marke von Bildung für Morgen)

Das Syntax Institut ist eine Marke von Bildung für Morgen und ein schnell wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen aus Berlin, das von erfolgreichen Unternehmern gegründet wurde. Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen praxisnah für gefragte Berufe in der Tech-Branche zu qualifizieren und sie erfolgreich in den Arbeitsmarkt zu integrieren. Unser Angebot umfasst praxisnahe Weiterbildungen in den Bereichen Softwareentwicklung, IT-Administration, Cloud & IT-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Projektmanagement. Darüber hinaus bieten wir deutschlandweit an mehreren Standorten Umschulungen im Bereich Fachinformatik an. Dabei vermitteln wir aktuelle Technologien, moderne Arbeitsmethoden und die Fähigkeiten, die Unternehmen heute tatsächlich benötigen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du bringst Erfahrung in IT-Administration und Cyber Security mit und möchtest dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung weitergeben? Dann teile dein Know-how als Senior Dozent*in beim Syntax Institut! Als Dozent*in gestaltest du die Lernerfahrung unserer Teilnehmenden und verantwortest ihren Erfolg. Du entwickelst praxisnahe sowie spannende Lehrinhalte und schaffst als Mentor*in eine fehlerfreundliche, wertschätzende und motivierende Lernatmosphäre auf Augenhöhe. Dein Ziel ist es, die Teilnehmenden zum Abschluss zu begleiten und das Fundament für eine erfolgreiche Integration in den Arbeitsmarkt zu legen. Gleichzeitig bringst du dein Wissen und deine Erfahrungen ins Team ein und teilst sie mit deinen Kolleg*innen, um auch gemeinsam voneinander zu lernen und die Qualität unserer Lehre weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Leitung und Durchführung von Kursen: Du führst täglich Online-Unterricht (e-Lectures, Live-Demonstrationen) am Vormittag durch und betreust die Kursteilnehmenden beim Selbststudium, bei Praxisaufgaben, in Intensivgruppen und in Sprechstunden (unterstützt durch einen Teaching Assistant).

  • Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Lehrmaterialien: Du erstellst praxisnahe Lernmaterialien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Produktteam. Weiterhin bist du verantwortlich für die fachliche und didaktische Qualität und dafür, die Lehrinhalte und Aufgaben zum Selbststudium kontinuierlich zu verbessern und zu aktualisieren.

  • Teilnehmerbetreuung und Kursmanagement: Du unterstützt die Teilnehmenden aktiv beim erfolgreichen Abschluss des Moduls, koordinierst die Aufgabenbearbeitung sowie deren Beurteilung und Reporting. Dabei bringst du dich aktiv in die tägliche Betreuung der Teilnehmenden ein, entwickelst gezielte Initiativen für leistungsschwächere Teilnehmende und arbeitest eng mit unserem Student Success Team zusammen.

Qualifikation

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Kenntnisse in IT-Administration und Cyber Security: Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Fachinformatiker, abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder vergleichbaren Abschluss. Neben deinen mindestens fünf Jahren praktischer Erfahrung hast du auch Erfahrung in der Lehre gesammelt. Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in der Netzwerktechnik (OSI-Modell, Routing, VLANs) und Systemadministration (Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux) mit. Du arbeitest sicher mit Virtualisierungslösungen wie Hyper-V und verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in der Netzwerksicherheit (Firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN). Die Automatisierung von Aufgaben über Skriptsprachen wie PowerShell und Bash ist dir ebenfalls vertraut.
    Darüber hinaus verfügst du über Kenntnisse in Blue- und Red-Team-Konzepten und hast praktische Erfahrung mit gängigen Security-Tools und -Plattformen, z. B. Snort, Suricata oder Wazuh. Ein fundiertes Verständnis etablierter Security-Standards, Frameworks und Referenzmodelle (z. B. NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK und OWASP Top 10) rundet dein Profil ab.

  • Analytisch und teamorientiert: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, denkst strukturiert und erklärst komplexe Themen logisch und nachvollziehbar. Dabei begeistert es dich, anderen dein Wissen zu vermitteln und sie aktiv beim Lernen zu unterstützen.

  • Proaktivität: Du hast ein Auge für Potenziale und arbeitest kontinuierlich an der Verbesserung der Inhalte mit.

  • Sprache und Kommunikation: Deine fließenden Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau) und deine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke runden dein Profil ab und ermöglichen es dir, Lerninhalte klar und motivierend zu vermitteln.

  • Freude am Lehren und Lernen: Dich begeistert es, anderen Wissen zu vermitteln und sie aktiv beim Lernen zu unterstützen. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und erklärst komplexe Themen logisch und nachvollziehbar. Du bringst eine Affinität zur (Online-)Lehre / E-Learning und web-basierten Lernprogrammen mit.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir

  • Ein Business mit Purpose: Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die wirtschaftlich, gesellschaftlich und sozial höchst relevant sind (Digitalisierung, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Wirtschaftsstandorts Deutschland, Arbeitsmarktpolitik, Gleichberechtigung, Technologie etc.).

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Als Dozent*in hast du einen großen Einfluss auf die Ausgestaltung unserer Kurse und die Entwicklung unseres Unternehmens.

  • Langzeitperspektive: Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und fördern deine Entwicklung. Falls du noch keinen AEVO-Schein besitzt, unterstützen wir dich bei deinem erfolgreichen Abschluss, damit du optimal für die Rolle aufgestellt bist.

  • Attraktives Package: Neben einem marktüblichen Gehalt profitierst du bei uns von einem vergünstigten Sportangebot und erhältst hochwertige Betriebsgeräte.

  • Tolles Team: Wir veranstalten regelmäßig Team-Events in Berlin und remote, damit auch der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt.

Wenn du glaubst, dass diese Rolle gut zu dir passt, bewirb dich gerne bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Wir freuen uns über deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit CV und optional einem kurzen Anschreiben.

Obecnie Palatine poszukuje, która obejmie stanowisko Media Buyera, czyli osoby, która w pełni przejmie odpowiedzialność za konto reklamowe Meta i będzie odpowiadać za jego skalowanie i efektywność.

To rola dla osoby, która na co dzień żyje kampaniami performance, dobrze czuje dynamikę pracy na dużych budżetach i chce skupić się na jednym koncie, zamiast dzielić uwagę między wielu klientów.

    • kompleksowe zarządzanie kontem reklamowym Meta Ads (Facebook),

    • skalowanie i optymalizacja budżetów, ustawianie i modyfikowanie cost capów,

    • dobrze odnajdujesz się w dynamicznym środowisku małej firmy, w którym liczy się efekt, a nie godziny spędzone przy komputerze.

Czego od Ciebie oczekujemy:

    • Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku,
    • doświadczenie w e-commerce / D2C / direct response,
    • bardzo dobra znajomość reklam Meta, struktur kampanii i optymalizacji pod sprzedaż,
    • język polski na poziomie zaawansowanym,
    • znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie B1/B2

Co oferujemy?

    • elastyczną formę współpracy (B2B, umowa zlecenie, umowa o pracę, umowa o dzieło),
    • pracę w 100% zdalną, także z dowolnego miejsca na świecie,
    • elastyczne godziny pracy, dostosowane do Twojego trybu dnia,
    • realny wpływ na wyniki firmy i szybką ścieżkę rozwoju,
    • dostęp do narzędzi AI,
    • możliwość otrzymania sprzętu firmowego.

raw.description:
About Get Flooring

At Get Flooring, we're not just laying down materials—we're crafting the very foundations of comfort and style in homes and businesses across the Midwest. Since our inception in 2009, we've been on a mission to enhance lives by transforming spaces, one floor at a time.

Over the last 11 years, we've expanded our footprint to four states—Illinois, Indiana, Wisconsin, and Michigan—and we're not stopping there. Our team of 25+ certified installers has successfully completed over 500 projects, covering more than 2 million square feet of flooring.

Our secret sauce? A blend of competitive pricing, top-notch quality, unwavering reliability, and stellar communication. We've had the privilege of working with renowned brands like Planet Fitness, Chipotle, and IMAX Theater, to name a few.

But what truly sets us apart is our vibrant and dynamic company culture. We believe in fostering an environment where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and every team member feels valued. At Get Flooring, you're not just joining a company—you're becoming part of a family that's reshaping the flooring industry.

If you're passionate about making a tangible impact and being part of a team that's revolutionizing spaces, join us in our journey to turn ordinary floors into extraordinary experiences.

We’re Hiring: Budgeting Specialist | Remote – Pakistan

Company: Get Flooring
Location: Pakistan (Remote)

Are you detail-oriented, comfortable with numbers, and experienced in budgeting and accounting? Join our team at Get Flooring!

Get Flooring is a commercial flooring company serving clients across the U.S. Midwest. We’re looking for a Budgeting Specialist who combines strong budgeting and cost-control skills with hands-on accounting experience to support our financial operations and project profitability.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys analyzing financial data, managing accounting tasks, monitoring project costs, and working with different departments to keep our business running efficiently.

What You’ll Do

Budgeting & Cost Control

  • Prepare and maintain project budgets, cost forecasts, and financial reports.

raw.description:
About NEXT.io

NEXT.io is a global media and events company connecting the people, ideas and businesses shaping the future of iGaming and emerging industries.

Through our international media platforms, industry-leading events and innovative content, we create meaningful connections, share insights and drive industries forward.

We're an ambitious, creative and collaborative team that's constantly evolving, exploring new opportunities and building what's NEXT.

The Role

Marketing & Growth runs across a portfolio of international B2B events and B2C affiliate brands. That means lots of campaigns, channels, deadlines and stakeholders, all moving at once. This role is what keeps it moving in the same direction. You will own the operational delivery of every marketing project, the marketing calendars, performance reporting, data, martech and attribution, and budget governance. You are the link between Marketing and every other department, and the reason we deliver on time, on budget and on numbers.

What You'll Actually Do

  • Support the Marketing & Growth Director — Act as the Director's right hand on planning,priorities and performance. Prepare the reporting, budget views and updates the Director needs, follow through on decisions, and keep the wider team aligned and moving.
  • Own Delivery Across the Portfolio — Take ownership of how every marketing project gets delivered across events and affiliates: briefs, timelines, owners, dependencies and sign-off. Nothing ships late because nobody owned it.
  • Run the Marketing Calendars — Build and maintain the master marketing calendars across the event portfolio and affiliate brands, working back from event dates and launch windows, so the whole team can see what is coming, who owns it and when it is due.
  • Build One Version of the Truth — Own performance reporting end to end: dashboards, weekly and monthly reporting, campaign wrap-ups and post-event reports. Define the KPIs, standardise how we measure and turn the numbers into decisions for the Director and leadership.
  • Fix Data and Attribution — Own tracking, UTM governance, analytics and CRM data quality, and the attribution model. We should know which channel drove which ticket, sponsor lead or affiliate conversion, and how much it cost.
  • Run the Martech Stack — Own our marketing tools (including HubSpot, GA4, Looker Studio, Supermetrics and monday.com): configuration, integrations, automations, licences and adoption. Make the stack simpler and more useful, not just bigger.
  • Govern the Budget — Own budget tracking, forecasting, spend and invoice logging, and reconciliation with Finance. Spot over- and under-spend early, and make sure every budget line has an owner and a reason.
  • Be the Link Between Departments — Run marketing request intake and prioritisation, own the team's operating rhythm (stand-ups, WIPs and retros), and keep Sales, Events, Content and Finance clear on what Marketing is doing and when.

Who You Are

  • You have run marketing operations at scale — Six or more years in marketing operations, growth operations or programme management. Ideally this includes multiple brands, events or a multi-channel agency.
  • You live in the data — You are fluent in GA4, tracking and attribution, dashboarding (Looker Studio or similar) and CRM (ideally HubSpot). You can build the report and explain what it means to people who don't read reports.
  • You are commercially literate — You are comfortable with budgets, forecasts, cost per acquisition, ROI and ROAS, and you can defend a budget line or cut one.
  • You build systems that stick — You create processes, templates and workflows that people actually use, in monday.com or a similar work-management tool.
  • You get things done through people who do not report to you — You can align marketers, designers, sales, events and finance around one plan and one set of deadlines.
  • You stay calm when the date can't move — Events have fixed deadlines. You plan backwards from them and protect them.
  • Bonus — Experience in iGaming, events or affiliate marketing.

What's in it for you?

  • Flexibility that works for you – flexible working hours and a remote-friendly environment built on trust and ownership.
  • A voice that matters – we encourage autonomy, welcome fresh ideas and give people the freedom to challenge the status quo.
  • Genuinely exciting projects – be part of an ambitious, evolving business where there's always something new happening and opportunities to make an impact.
  • A collaborative environment – work alongside talented, approachable people who support one another and celebrate shared successes.
  • Room to grow – continuous learning and professional development opportunities, supported by NEXT Academy and other initiatives.
  • Additional perks & benefits – a range of benefits designed to support our people, with specific offerings varying depending on your location.

Why Join Us?

You will never be just another name on the team list. This role sits at the centre of a fast-growing marketing function. It sets how the team plans, measures and spends, so your work will shape every campaign we run across both sides of the business.

  • Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too!

  • Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.

Yay! You've made it this far!

But there’s one more thing we want to say: Don’t hesitate! Especially if you’re a woman, or from an underrepresented group. Even if you don’t check every box, we want to encourage you to apply anyway. raw.description:
Description

We're looking for a senior, experienced Product Owner to lead growth phase and take products to the next level to become one of our main revenue engines.

Product Owner will lead:

  • Sheet Music Plus - a direct-to-consumer retail site that offers sheet music to musicians in every genre, at every level from beginner to pro.
  • Sheet Music Direct - a professional mobile app offering access to over 2.2 million licensed sheet music titles from Hal Leonard and partner publishers.

What is in it for you?

Own a product used by millions - Shape the future of the applications used by performers, educators, and serious hobbyists looking for a distraction-free, professional sheet music experience.

Radical ownership and impact - Full end-to-end ownership of strategy, roadmap, and delivery.

Experimenation engine - Design the experimentation engine, uncover new revenue streams and subscriptions.

We are actively integrating AI automation into relevant areas of the business and expect candidates with mindset focused on improving efficiency and deliver a better user experience.

Key responsibilities

Monetization & revenue

  • Own the monetization roadmap; accelerate the pace of monetization initiatives (release-to-release, not quarter-to-quarter)
  • Drive feature implementation speed— reduce time from decision to release
  • Build and maintain a close working connection with the monetization team: shared backlog visibility, joint prioritization, aligned experiment pipeline

Metrics & plan/fact

  • Own the product metric layer: definitions, data quality, dashboards
  • Resolve outstanding metric issues (gaps, broken tracking, conflicting sources)
  • Run regular plan-vs-fact reviews; explain deviations with a clear causal narrative, not descriptive reporting

Product bets & discovery

  • Identify and validate big product bets— hypotheses with a quantified business upside, not feature ideas
  • Establish a working discovery process in both products: hypothesis → research → decision, each discovery framed with an expected business outcome
  • Run a monthly backlog refresh cycle: re-prioritize against business goals and current team capacity

AI in the team process

  • Introduce AI-native ways of working into the team workflow: design-system-driven development, templates, agents, design agents
  • Make AI usage a default part of the delivery process (specs, design, frontend, research), not an individual experiment

Delivery ownership

  • Own backlog, prioritization, and release scope
  • Make product decisions proactively — surface tradeoffs and decide, rather than escalating for direction

People Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and grow the team of 7 people

Requirements

Hard skills:

  • Min 5+ years as Product Owner / Product Manager on a B2C digital product with a subscription or transactional revenue model
  • Proven track record of monetization work: pricing, paywall, conversion, subscription funnel — with revenue impact you can quantify
  • Experience in people management
  • Strong analytical foundation
  • Experience owning discovery end to end: framing hypotheses, choosing research method, converting findings into roadmap decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to increase delivery speed in an existing team — shortening cycle time without dropping quality (using AI tools)
  • Proactive decision-making: comfortable making calls with incomplete data and owning the outcome
  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Soft skills:

  • Can work under revenue pressure
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills

Benefits

Creativity every day: Make inspiring products for musicians, artists and creators – no day is the same.

Impactful work Influence the future of the music industry and change the lives of millions worldwide.

Work set up: We’ll make sure you’re set up for success with the right work equipment, whether that’s company-provided hardware or an equipment allowance.

Growth and development: Receive specialized training, language lessons, conferences and learning materials.

Team well-being: Support for your mental health and wellbeing, including confidential help during life’s tougher moments.

Cyberdrone is an international pioneer in drone light shows, creating extraordinary visual experiences through proprietary drone technology, in-house engineering, and world-class creative production.

The Opportunity

Our head office is in Dubai and we already have a strong artist team over there.

Now, we're expanding our office in Brazil (São Paulo) with a goal to cover shows in South America & the United States, and we're looking for someone who wants to help build something exceptional.

We're looking for a Drone Show Designer (3D Artist) over there who will work with our existing team. You would help them design and develop state-of-the-art animations for our clients. Do you want to paint the sky with your art? Apply now!

This is a remote role, with preference given to candidates based in São Paulo to meet the local team and collaborate in person.

Tasks:

  • Developing 3D models for drone shows
  • Developing animations and transitions for drone shows
  • Running physics checks and making corrections
  • Developing take-off and landing sequences
  • Implementing feedback according to the technical or client requirements
  • Creating static preview and animation preview renders
  • Assembling ready shows and preparing them for flight

Requirements:

  • Bachelor of Arts/Design or 5+ Years industry experience
  • 2+ Years industry experience in drone shows, motion design, game-dev (TechArt/Real-Time VFX) or VFX
  • Working knowledge of physically based simulation techniques
  • Deep understanding of the CG animation pipelines
  • Working knowledge of task-management frameworks and software tools.
  • Working knowledge of the client approval process
  • Able to manage a time-sensitive workload with an urgent and extremely organized manner
  • High attitude to details
  • Experience working with off-site team members
  • Analytical problem-solving skills
  • Team player approach with the ability to take direction/feedback

Required Software Proficiency:

  • Houdini
  • Blender
  • Compositing (AE/Nuke/DaVinci Resolve)
  • Photoshop & Illustrator essentials

Benefits:

  • Can be fully remote
  • Competitive salary

Why Join Cyberdrone?

An established international company. A brand-new US market. The opportunity to make your mark.

Our culture is built around six core values: We Collab. We Care. We Deliver. We Dare. We Adapt. We Grow.

We believe talented people thrive when they're trusted to take ownership, encouraged to challenge the conventional, and supported by a team that shares their ambition. We value open communication, mutual respect, creative thinking, and accountability - giving people the freedom to do their best work.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants more than their next design role. We're looking for a driven professional who is passionate about exploring new creative frontiers, excited by the challenge of developing immersive shows, and motivated by the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Join Cyberdrone and help shape the future of drone entertainment in the United States.

The Senior Security Analyst, Financial Systems is a senior member of the GFiT Governance & Security team and is responsible for leading and executing advanced security monitoring, risk assessment, and control activities across the GFiT environment. This role plays a key part in identifying, analyzing, and mitigating complex security risks impacting financial systems and data, while ensuring alignment with corporate security standards, ITGC/SOX requirements, and regulatory expectations.

In addition to hands‑on security operations, the Senior Security Analyst provides subject‑matter expertise during system implementations, enhancements, and incident response activities; partners closely with application, infrastructure, and governance teams; and supports internal and external audits. This role is expected to operate with a high degree of independence and contribute to continuous improvement of security processes and controls within the GFiT environment.

Responsibilities

  • Security Monitoring & Incident Management

    • Lead advanced monitoring and analysis of security alerts and logs from security tools, identifying trends, anomalies, and potential threats impacting GFiT financial systems.

    • Perform in‑depth investigation of complex security events and incidents, including root‑cause analysis, impact assessment, and coordination of remediation efforts with technical teams.

    • Serve as an escalation point for higher‑risk or cross‑functional security issues.

  • Risk Assessment & Control Oversight

    • Conduct and support security risk assessments across the GFiT environment, identifying control gaps and recommending risk‑based remediation strategies.

    • Evaluate the security impact of system changes, new applications, and enhancements, ensuring risks are identified and addressed early in the lifecycle.

    • Support ongoing ITGC and SOX control execution related to security monitoring, access management, and incident response.

  • Implementation & Change Support

    • Act as a security subject‑matter expert during implementations of new applications, integrations, and infrastructure changes, advising on secure design and configuration.

    • Partner with application, infrastructure, and PMO teams to ensure security considerations are embedded into delivery plans.

  • Audit, Compliance & Documentation

    • Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external auditors, supporting walkthroughs, evidence collection, and remediation discussions related to financial systems security.

    • Review and validate security documentation, procedures, and evidence to ensure audit readiness and consistency.

    • Identify opportunities to strengthen control design, documentation quality, and audit efficiency.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Provide guidance to GFiT team members, supporting knowledge sharing and skill development.

    • Contribute to the development and refinement of security standards, procedures, and operational practices within GFiT.

    • Proactively identify opportunities to improve security monitoring, reporting, and operational effectiveness and raise to GFiT leadership.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Management or a related field.

  • Professional certification in compliance or financial systems (e.g., GIFS, CISM, CEH, SSCP) is preferred.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with internal and external security/audit representatives.

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in IT Security, Security Operations, IT Audit and/or compliance of financial systems.

  • Proven track record of managing security initiatives and regulatory assessments.

  • Experience with security/regulatory standards and best practices in financial systems.

raw.title: Deputy Chief Executive Officer (Deputy CEO)
raw.excerpt: ROLE PURPOSEThe Deputy Chief Executive Officer serves as the principal execution leader of the company and acts as the Chief Executive Officer's primary partner in the management and delivery of the Company's strategic, operational, commercial, and financial objectives.
raw.description:
ROLE PURPOSE

The Deputy Chief Executive Officer serves as the principal execution leader of the company and acts as the Chief Executive Officer's primary partner in the management and delivery of the Company's strategic, operational, commercial, and financial objectives.

The role is responsible for overseeing the Company's core revenue-generating businesses, driving organizational performance, ensuring effective execution of strategic initiatives, fostering alignment across business units, and maintaining accountability for the achievement of approved business plans and financial targets.

The Deputy CEO provides day-to-day leadership and coordination across the enterprise, ensuring that strategic priorities approved by the Board and Executive Management are translated into measurable outcomes. The role is specifically intended to create organizational capacity for the CEO to focus on strategic growth initiatives, business development, capital management, enterprise risk oversight, stakeholder engagement, funding activities, acquisitions, and long-term transformation initiatives.

The Deputy CEO will serve as Acting Chief Executive Officer when required and will represent the Company internally and externally as delegated by the CEO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Leadership & Business Performance

  • Support the CEO in the overall leadership and management of the company.
  • Drive execution of the Company's strategic plan and annual business objectives.
  • Ensure alignment between corporate strategy, departmental priorities, and individual performance objectives.
  • Lead the execution of initiatives designed to enhance profitability, efficiency, productivity, and shareholder value.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, performance excellence, collaboration, innovation, and client-centricity.
  • Ensure timely identification and resolution of operational, commercial, and organizational challenges.
  • Act as the primary executive responsible for translating strategy into execution.

Commercial Leadership & Revenue Management

Provide executive oversight for the Company's core client-facing and revenue-generating businesses, including:

  • Investment Banking
  • Sales & Services
  • Wealth Management
  • Trading & Brokerage
  • Treasury & Financial Institutions

Responsibilities include:

  • Driving revenue growth and market share expansion.
  • Monitoring business performance against approved budgets and targets.
  • Identifying opportunities for revenue enhancement and business development.
  • Ensuring effective cross-selling and collaboration across business lines.
  • Supporting the development and execution of commercial strategies.
  • Monitoring client acquisition, retention, and relationship management initiatives.
  • Ensuring business units operate efficiently and profitably.

Strategic Execution & Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide implementation of strategic initiatives approved by the Board and Executive Committee.
  • Establish and maintain mechanisms to monitor strategic initiative delivery.
  • Ensure strategic projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with approved objectives.
  • Coordinate execution across business units and support functions.
  • Identify and escalate barriers to execution and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support organizational transformation initiatives and business process improvements.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and execution excellence.

Executive Management & Organizational Coordination

  • Serve as a key member of the Executive Management Team.
  • Coordinate management activities across business lines and support functions.
  • Chair executive and management meetings as delegated by the CEO.
  • Monitor execution of management action items and strategic priorities.
  • Drive accountability across the leadership team.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments.
  • Ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities.

Financial Performance & Resource Management

  • Partner with the CEO and CFO to achieve approved financial objectives.
  • Monitor financial performance across business units.
  • Drive disciplined expense management and resource optimization.
  • Ensure business units operate within approved budgets.
  • Monitor key financial indicators and recommend corrective actions where required.
  • Support the preparation and execution of annual business plans and budgets.
  • Ensure efficient deployment of financial and operational resources.

Operational Oversight & Service Excellence

Through direct leadership and collaboration with operational stakeholders:

  • Promote operational excellence across the organization.
  • Maintain oversight of critical operational performance metrics.
  • Work closely with the VP Operations and VP Information Technology to ensure effective execution of operational and technology priorities.
  • Support service delivery improvements and client experience initiatives.
  • Ensure business continuity and operational resilience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and service quality.
  • Support implementation of technology-enabled solutions to improve organizational effectiveness.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Oversight

  • Support the CEO in maintaining a strong governance and control environment.
  • Ensure effective implementation of Board and Executive Committee decisions.
  • Monitor the status of regulatory, audit, compliance, and risk management initiatives.
  • Support the remediation of operational, regulatory, and governance issues.
  • Promote adherence to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
  • Foster a culture of ethical conduct and accountability throughout the organization.
  • Ensure significant issues are escalated appropriately and addressed promptly.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Represent the Company in meetings with clients, regulators, industry bodies, and business partners as delegated.
  • Support initiatives designed to enhance the Company's reputation and market position.
  • Collaborate with senior management to strengthen client and stakeholder relationships.

Acting Chief Executive Officer

  • Serve as Acting CEO in the absence of the Chief Executive Officer.
  • Exercise delegated authority as assigned by the CEO and Board of Directors.
  • Represent the Company in executive-level engagements when required.
  • Provide leadership continuity during periods of CEO absence.

ETHICS, CONDUCT & SECURITY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Uphold the highest standards of integrity, professionalism, confidentiality, and ethical conduct.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, policies, and governance standards.
  • Safeguard confidential, proprietary, and client information.
  • Promote a culture of transparency, accountability, and responsible corporate citizenship.
  • Support cybersecurity, information security, and business continuity initiatives.
  • Report and address any identified ethical, regulatory, or operational concerns.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

  • Master's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management, Accounting, Law, or a related discipline.
  • Professional designation such as CFA®, FRM®, CAIA®, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent.

Experience

  • Minimum twelve (12) years of progressively senior leadership experience within financial services, banking, capital markets, investment management, wealth management, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple business units and senior leaders.
  • Proven track record of driving business growth, operational performance, and organizational transformation.
  • Experience leading strategic initiatives and complex organizational projects.
  • Strong understanding of financial services regulation and governance frameworks.
  • Experience operating at Executive Committee or Board level would be considered a strong asset.

CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Leadership & Management

  • Strategic leadership
  • Executive presence
  • Team leadership and talent development
  • Change leadership
  • Performance management
  • Decision-making and judgment

Commercial & Financial Acumen

  • Business strategy execution
  • Revenue growth and profitability management
  • Financial analysis and performance management
  • Budgeting and resource allocation
  • Capital markets and financial services knowledge

Operational Excellence

  • Enterprise execution
  • Process improvement
  • Organizational effectiveness
  • Technology enablement
  • Risk-based decision making

Relationship Management

  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Negotiation and influence
  • Conflict resolution
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Client relationship management

Personal Attributes

  • High integrity and professionalism
  • Strong execution orientation
  • Resilience and adaptability
  • Sound judgment
  • Results-driven mindset
  • Exceptional communication skills

KEY RELATIONSHIPS

Internal

  • Chief Executive Officer
  • Executive Management Team
  • Board of Directors
  • Investment Banking
  • Sales & Services
  • Wealth Management
  • Trading & Brokerage
  • Treasury & Financial Institutions
  • Asset Management & Research
  • Finance
  • Operations
  • Information Technology
  • Risk Management
  • Compliance
  • Legal
  • Human Resources

External

  • Clients
  • Regulators
  • Industry Associations
  • Financial Institutions
  • Business Partners
  • Professional Advisors
  • Vendors and Service Providers

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Financial Performance

  • Achievement of annual revenue targets.
  • Achievement of profitability objectives.
  • Cost-to-income ratio performance.
  • Business line budget achievement.

Strategic Execution

  • Percentage of strategic initiatives delivered on time.
  • Achievement of annual corporate objectives.
  • Successful implementation of transformation initiatives.
  • Closure of executive action items.

Operational Excellence

  • Service delivery performance.
  • Operational efficiency improvements.
  • Technology and operational project execution.
  • Client experience metrics.

Leadership & Culture

  • Employee engagement and leadership effectiveness.
  • Talent retention and succession readiness.
  • Cross-functional collaboration effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction.

Governance & Risk

  • Regulatory and audit issue remediation.
  • Compliance with governance standards.
  • Timely implementation of Board and Executive directives.
  • Reduction in operational risk events.

SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS

  • The position operates in a fast-paced executive environment requiring significant interaction with internal and external stakeholders.
  • The role will require flexibility beyond normal business hours, including occasional evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
  • The role may involve domestic and international travel.
  • The incumbent will regularly participate in Board meetings, Executive Committee meetings, regulatory engagements, client meetings, and strategic planning sessions.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

The Deputy Chief Executive Officer role has been established to strengthen organizational execution, enhance management capacity, and ensure disciplined delivery of the company's strategic, commercial, and operational objectives. The position serves as the Company's principal internal leader, enabling the Chief Executive Officer to focus on growth, business development, capital management, stakeholder engagement, enterprise risk oversight, and long-term transformation initiatives.

Are you a German language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for German speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for German language specialists who live and breathe German grammar, syntax, morphology, phonology, semantics, and pragmatics. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like verb conjugation, case system (nominative, accusative, dative, genitive), word order, declensions, gender, and stylistic variation—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A master’s or PhD in German language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, teaching experience, or hands-on linguistic analysis projects signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your German language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

Field Engineering Manager

Location

Remote (U.S.) with periodic travel to customer sites, TurbineOne facilities, demonstrations, and operational events as required.

About TurbineOne

TurbineOne is building Mission-AI for the Frontlines. Our Frontline Perception System (FPS) helps military and national security operators detect threats, accelerate decision-making, and unlock the power of AI at the tactical edge. We endeavor to build mission-valuable products in command and control, autonomy, and AI-enabled mission systems. We partner directly with frontline users to deliver mission-ready capabilities that work in real-world environments where speed, trust, reliability, and operational resilience matter most.

Our team is composed of experienced technologists, veterans, and operators committed to advancing national security through responsible innovation.

The Role

TurbineOne is seeking a Field Engineering Manager to lead our Field Engineering function, responsible for the technical leadership of field integrations, helping shape how TurbineOne deploys, scales, and supports our Frontline Perception System (FPS) in diverse operational environments.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You will manage a talented team of Field Engineers while remaining technically engaged in integration architecture, tooling development, and on-site deployment execution. You'll help the team prioritize integration efforts, remove obstacles, and ensure field teams and customers can execute missions reliably and repeatedly.

Unlike traditional SaaS organizations, TurbineOne delivers mission-critical AI software into customer-owned environments ranging from enterprise cloud infrastructure to tactical edge systems supporting U.S. national security missions. Success requires balancing engineering velocity with operational reliability, cybersecurity, and government compliance.

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Engineering Operations, you will work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, and Mission Operations to ensure our field deployment capabilities continue to scale alongside our rapidly growing customer base.

What You'll Do

Lead the Field Engineering Team

  • Manage and mentor a high-performing team of field engineers, fostering a culture of ownership and technical excellence.
  • Define and standardize deployment workflows and integration playbooks to improve repeatability and reliability.
  • Ensure the operational readiness of field personnel through continuous training, robust documentation, and deployment guides.

Provide Technical Leadership

  • Set the technical strategy for field integrations, identifying gaps in current processes and implementing scalable solutions.
  • Lead the implementation and improvement of field engineering tooling, scripts (Python, Go, Bash), and automation workflows.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical integration challenges and troubleshoot high-stakes mission issues.

Build Secure Mission Infrastructure

  • Oversee the provisioning and configuration of FPS deployments within customer-owned tactical edge systems.
  • Ensure secure software delivery into comms-contested environments where speed and operational resilience are paramount.
  • Partner with Security and Product teams to align field implementation patterns with government compliance and mission requirements.

Partner Across the Company

  • Work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Mission Operations, Field Engineering, and executive leadership.
  • Translate business priorities into actionable Field Engineering initiatives.
  • Clearly communicate priorities, risks, dependencies, timelines, and technical tradeoffs.
  • Support customer deployments, demonstrations, exercises, and mission events as needed.

Drive Mission Readiness

  • Ensure every Field Engineer is fully prepared before customer deployments, including technical readiness, certifications, and required training.
  • Maintain readiness tracking for personnel, specialized technical skills, software versions, deployment kits, and customer-specific requirements.

Build Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures supporting field operations.
  • Establish metrics and dashboards for deployment readiness, utilization, customer support, and operational performance.
  • Conduct post-deployment reviews to capture and implement operational lessons learned.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in Field Engineering, Systems Integration, Solutions Architecture, or related technical deployment roles.
  • 4+ years of experience leading or managing technical teams.
  • Extensive experience with Linux systems, networking, and deploying software in complex or edge-based infrastructure.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized application deployment.
  • Strong proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation and data routing.
  • Experience supporting production software deployed into customer-controlled, hybrid, or mission environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing technical work while leading high-performing engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of networking, cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, automation, monitoring, logging, and operational reliability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • U.S. Citizenship.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance.

Preferred

  • Active Top Secret or Secret Security Clearance.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense or Intelligence Community software programs.
  • Experience supporting software accreditation activities, including RMF, ATO, and IATT processes.
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, or similar modern infrastructure tooling.
  • Experience deploying software into tactical edge, disconnected, or customer-hosted environments.
  • Familiarity with secure software supply chain practices and modern DevSecOps principles.
  • Experience working in high-growth startup environments.
  • Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, edge computing, or mission software.

What Success Looks Like

  • The Field Engineering team consistently executes against clearly defined priorities with high reliability across all customer sites.
  • Customer deployments occur smoothly with minimal operational disruption.
  • Field Engineering tools and processes mature over time to support the growth of the company.
  • Field tooling and standardized workflows significantly reduce time-to-deployment and increase on-site success rates..
  • Field Engineering is viewed as a strategic enabler that bridges the gap between core engineering and tactical mission success.
  • Team members grow professionally while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

Why Join TurbineOne

At TurbineOne, your work directly supports the people operating at the frontlines of national security. You'll lead the team responsible for ensuring our mission-critical AI software reaches operators quickly, securely, and reliably in the most challenging environments.

You'll join a team of experienced technologists, veterans, and mission-focused professionals committed to solving some of the nation's most challenging operational problems through responsible innovation.

If you're passionate about building high-performing engineering teams, creating scalable technical infrastructure, and delivering technology that makes a measurable difference for those serving on the frontlines, we'd love to hear from you.
