raw.description:
About Voltus

Voltus is the leading platform connecting distributed energy resources to electricity markets, delivering more affordable, reliable, and sustainable power. Our commercial and industrial (C&I) customers, along with our residential and grid services partners, earn revenue by allowing Voltus to maximize the value of their flexible load, distributed generation, energy storage, energy efficiency, and electric vehicle resources. Our product is tested and proven, and we have moved from startup to a stage of significant, rapid growth. We believe in "doing well by doing good," which includes doing right by our team, customers, and partners.

The Role

    Voltus is seeking a Battery Sales Director to build and grow a book of battery customers across the Mid-Atlantic and Great Lakes regions. As load growth accelerates, the grid faces structural constraints, and speed-to-power and affordability have become foundational to economic growth. Voltus has a long history of delivering faster, cleaner, lower-cost capacity by optimizing existing infrastructure. Now we are creating even more value by helping customers deploy batteries that cut their energy costs further. In this role, you will develop the customer relationships that make this possible, working directly with the facilities, manufacturers, and institutions that will host batteries on-site to create grid capacity.

    Key metrics: MW of battery Letters of Intent (LOIs) signed, MW of Energy Services Agreements (ESAs) signed, and MW of batteries enrolled in market programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound calls, email outreach, and self-sourced lead development across the territory

  • Lead the sales cycle from first call through contract close, working closely with our partnerships team and battery partners.

  • Build relationships with energy, operations, and finance decision-makers at hospitals, universities, large manufacturers, and municipalities

  • Educate prospects on Voltus's battery offerings and translate grid economics into operational and financial value for each account

  • Maintain accurate pipeline data, forecasts, and deal activity in the CRM

  • Share market intelligence with internal and partner teams, and help refine outreach strategy and improve close rates over time

Who You Are

    You understand how C&I customers think and how to help an organization make a complex energy decision quickly. You are customer-focused and detail-oriented over a long sales and development cycle, and you collaborate well with senior stakeholders at customers, partners, and across Voltus. You adapt quickly to change in a dynamic industry. An open mind and grit are essential.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience, with a proven track record of self-generated outbound prospecting and closing net-new business

  • Experience selling into C&I accounts; existing relationships with hospital groups, universities, large manufacturers, or municipalities in the region are a strong plus

  • Battery or similar energy industry sales and development experience strongly preferred

  • Coachable and feedback-oriented, with a long-term mindset

  • A genuine team player who shares insights and lessons learned

  • Comfort with self-direction and ambiguity

Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).

Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.

Description

We are looking for a Business & Supply Chain Analyst who will help transform operational data into actionable business intelligence across global distribution and procurement operations. The role focuses on building reliable data foundations, automating reporting and analytics, and creating transparency across logistics, inventory, costs, and operational performance.

We are actively integrating AI automation into relevant areas of the business and expect candidates with mindset focused on improving efficiency and deliver a better user experience.

Key responsibilities

Build Operational Data Foundation

  • Build and automate a unified operational dataset by integrating data from Navision, AS400, WMS/voice-pick, and NetSuite.
  • Create documented, reproducible data processes independent of individual knowledge.
  • Develop scalable data pipelines and structures to support analytics and automation.
  • Define operational data and reporting requirements for ERP transformation.
  • Ensure analytics needs are built into new systems from the start.
  • Establish agreed baselines for operational costs and FTEs with Finance and HR.
  • Track improvement initiatives and ensure savings are measured consistently.

Deliver Operational Intelligence

  • Provide visibility into key operational metrics: fill rate, throughput, SLA performance, backlog, lead times, site productivity, cost-to-serve, inventory health.
  • Implement automated anomaly detection and operational monitoring.
  • Build and maintain a procurement spend cube
  • Support procurement decisions through: Category baselines, Supplier performance analysis, Price and demand monitoring, Savings tracking.

Network & Operational Modelling

  • Build scenario models for strategic decisions
  • European distribution consolidation.
  • US warehouse/hub design.
  • Print-on-demand footprint optimization.
  • Quantify impact based on volume, space, cost-to-serve, and headcount.
  • Build data foundations for AI-assisted workflows: Forecasting, Anomaly detection, Inventory health monitoring, Automated approval processes.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Supply Chain Analyst in operations, logistics, distribution, or manufacturing.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with ERP data (Navision/Dynamics, AS400/DB2, NetSuite, or similar legacy systems).
  • Ability to work with complex and undocumented data models.
  • Strong BI expertise (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
  • Experience with Python or advanced Excel for modelling.
  • Data engineering mindset: automation, documentation, reproducibility, and scalable solutions over manual reporting.
  • Ability to communicate insights to senior stakeholders and challenge assumptions with data.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have

  • Procurement analytics experience (spend cubes, should-cost models, supplier analytics).
  • Experience with network, footprint, or cost-to-serve modelling.
  • Applied AI/ML experience (forecasting, anomaly detection, AI-ready data foundations).
  • Experience supporting ERP migrations or system consolidation projects.
  • Knowledge of Dutch or German.

Regional Sales Representative, 3M Electrical Markets Division; Houston, TX


Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.


This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.


The Impact You’ll Make in this Role


As an EMD C&I End-User Sales Professional, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:


  • Driving profitable sales for the C&I business in the assigned territory.
  • Developing, implementing, and executing effective territory business plans.
  • Prioritizing your end customers, markets, and distributors to drive effective territory management.
  • Implementing promotions, and directives as set by division management.
  • Collaborating across other C&I territories and within other 3M EMD Divisions to meet customer needs.

Company Vehicle

This position requires driving a company vehicle, which will require pre-employment and ongoing review of motor vehicle history for candidates who are offered and hired for this position


Your Skills and Expertise 

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) AND three (3) years direct sales and/or electrical construction/industrial experience in a private, public, government or military environment.

OR

  • Associate's degree (completed and verified prior to start) and five (5) years of electrical industry sales experience in a private, public, government or military environment

AND

  • Current, valid driver’s license.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:


  • Sales experience in the Electric Contractor Market.
  • Strong negotiation and relationship building skills.
  • Aptitude to understand and train customers on multiple product lines and applications.
  • Experience selling through distribution.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to all levels.
  • Ability to qualify and prioritize sales opportunities within assigned territory.
  • Experience working in a matrix environment or large complex organization.
  • Strong computer skills, Database management: PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Salesforce.com.
  • Strong oral, written and presentation skills.
  • Strong team player, ability to work effectively with peers.

Work location:

  • Remote: Based on assigned Territory: East TX and Houston

Travel: May include up to 50% domestic

Relocation Assistance: May be authorized


Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).


Supporting Your Well-being

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Chat with Max

For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.

Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.
Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.
We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.
Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, andthe results speak for themselves.
From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.
And now? Now we are looking for a Front-end Developer who will help our Web Development Team create and implement a wide variety of web-based products using Go, , or PHP, and who wants to take their career one step further. If you think you are one of those people, here you will have the chance to work with the world's leading brands using Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning technologies. Right now, while you are reading this, we are sending an average of 2.2 billion requests and almost 2 billion instant notifications to more than 450 servers a day. On the Artificial Intelligence and Predictive side, we have more than 100 TB of historical data. We do not wait for jobs or opportunities to come to our feet — we create them. We have now reached 25% of global users. If all of this interests you, read on for more!
Our Engineers and Software Developers always think with an innovative perspective, taking advantage of the inexhaustible power of the digital world. They create impressive and intelligent products like true artists. Our Product and Development teams are located in our Istanbul office, so we produce and develop the technology we export to the world in our own country. At Insider One, we believe in cooperation and in adapting the innovations brought by technology by acting fast. We work closely with other departments with agile teams, and we are not afraid of getting our hands dirty. As we said, we do not wait for jobs or opportunities to come to our feet — we create them ourselves. You can check our Tech Stacks here!:

What You Will Do

  • participates in the entire project life cycle, from product development and release to maintenance,
  • researches, evaluates, and shares existing and upcoming new technologies with the team,
  • provides communication with Product Managers, Designers, teammates, and co-working teams in order to write efficient code,
  • produces new ideas to develop new features/setups or to improve existing applications and processes, and develops POC applications when necessary to demonstrate ideas,
  • works closely with Back-End Developers to communicate with APIs,
  • provides control of error channels to keep product quality at the highest level,
  • writes code in a reusable, manageable, scalable way,
  • is responsible for the maintenance and performance of new features in the front end,
  • aims to keep code quality and information sharing at the highest level with daily code reviews.

What You Will Need

  • have 4+ years of experience as a Front-end Developer, working with modern tools and libraries (e.g. NPM, Vite, Webpack, Babel), and micro front-end architectures.
  • have hands-on, daily experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot. At Insider One, AI is part of how we build every day, not an experiment,
  • are comfortable working in an AI-first development workflow: planning, implementing, refactoring, testing, and reviewing code together with AI agents,
  • know how to write effective prompts and give agents the right context (e.g., CLAUDE.md, project rules, skills, MCP servers), and can tell when AI output is wrong,
  • review AI-generated code critically and take full ownership of its quality, security, and maintainability,
  • are curious and constantly experimenting with new AI tools, models, and workflows, and enjoy sharing what you learn with the team,
  • have experience working in an Agile team,
  • have experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, ,
  • have a deep understanding of , including experience with both the Composition API and the Options API,
  • have experience with Sass or other compiled CSS languages and have experience in responsive web design,
  • stay up to date on emerging technologies,
  • have good knowledge of version control systems (e.g. Git),
  • have experience in optimizing page performance,
  • are in tune with maintaining, scaling, and monitoring systems,
  • are familiar with application performance and error-tracking apps (e.g. Sentry, Datadog, Site24x7, etc.),
  • have the ability to write clean and semantic front-end code,
  • have experience in Unit, Visual, and E2E Testing,
  • are self-motivated, independent, organized, proactive, and highly responsive when working across multiple teams,
  • are open to developing and learning new technologies,
  • have a visionary mindset,
  • having knowledge and experience in TypeScript is a bonus.

What We Offer

  • Enjoy a monthly meal allowance designed to enhance your daily routine.
  • Access comprehensive private health insurance.
  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, Neoskola, and CloudGuru.
  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.
  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets, where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.
  • Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.
  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.
  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.
  • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.
  • Get inspired by the greatest minds in the tech industry through events like our Tech & Dev Talks.
  • Work from anywhere in Turkey through our fully remote setup.
We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.
To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

raw.title: Senior Account Manager
raw.excerpt: About AMZ Advisers:AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces.
raw.description:
About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

To Apply Please Include the Following:

  • Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered)

  • Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work

  • Answers to the following questions:

    • Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central.

    • Do you have any experience leading a team?

    • Why are you interested in a new job/ this position?

    • Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

raw.description:
Job Summary

The Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) is the executive leader responsible for using enterprise data, advanced analytics, AI, and business intelligence to improve strategic and operational decision-making.

Within Insurance & Investments, the CAO typically oversees analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer intelligence, fraud, risk, actuarial insights, investment performance, portfolio analytics, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the organization's enterprise analytics strategy.

Establish an enterprise-wide analytics operating model, roadmap, standards, and priorities.

Lead advanced analytics, predictive analytics, AI/ML, data science, and business intelligence.

Translate complex data into actionable insights for CEO, Board, executives, and business leaders.

Develop analytics capabilities for:

Underwriting and risk selection

Claims and loss analysis

Pricing and profitability

Customer segmentation and retention

Fraud detection

Risk and capital analytics

Portfolio and investment performance

Asset allocation

Market and investment research

Financial forecasting

Regulatory and management reporting

Establish enterprise analytics KPIs and measurement frameworks.

Drive predictive modelling and scenario analysis to support strategic decisions.

Partner with the CIO/CDO/CTO on data architecture, data platforms, governance, integration, and technology modernization.

Ensure analytical models use reliable, governed, secure, and appropriately controlled data.

Develop self-service BI and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities for AI and automation across business functions.

Establish model governance, validation, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.

Support actuarial, risk, finance, investment, compliance, and executive decision-making.

Lead enterprise analytics transformation and data-driven culture.

Build, manage, and develop high-performing teams across analytics, data science, BI, and AI.

Manage analytics budgets, vendors, strategic technology partners, and external data providers.

Communicate analytical findings and business implications to senior executives and the Board.

Ensure analytics activities align with regulatory, privacy, risk, and financial-services requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of experience across analytics, data science, BI, statistics, quantitative analysis, or related fields.

7+ years in senior analytics/data leadership.

Previous experience as:

Chief Analytics Officer

Chief Data & Analytics Officer

Chief Data Officer

Head of Data & Analytics

Head of Analytics

Group Head of Analytics

Director of Data & Analytics

Analytics Director

VP Data & Analytics

Strong experience in Insurance, Banking, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services.

Strong understanding of:

Advanced analytics

Predictive modelling

AI/ML

Data science

Business intelligence

Data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

Statistical modelling

Data visualization

Scenario/stress testing

Experience converting analytics into measurable business outcomes.

Strong executive stakeholder management and Board-level communication.

Experience leading large, multidisciplinary analytics/data teams.

Strong commercial and strategic understanding of financial-services businesses.

Bachelor's degree required; Master's/PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, or a related field is advantageous.
